lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Линейка расстояния на карте
value.meaning: Ruler measures map distance represented by its screen span, not a GPS range or selected feature length.
value.value_origin: rulerText property: screen endpoints -> screenToMap -> EPSG3857 GeoLineString.length -> LocationUtil.formatLength; camera idle binds text
value.units: Map distance formatted using preferred_units; bitmap span10mm/notch1mm.
conditions: Laid-out ruler and projection available; show_scale_ruler defaults false; current mode can hide it.
value.saved_state: Visibility/units preferences persist; text is derived, not feature data.
expectations: Fixed GPS with changed camera zoom changes represented span. Counterexample: ruler does not measure distance to phone.
unknowns: Runtime NOT_RUN: no GUI, device, emulator, build or APK resource merge acceptance in this task.
rulerText is a property, not a method: exact source/prose is in map-review.md. Projection/metric correctness and layout measurement remain separate acceptance.
